title: Euler's Formula
description: Raise e to an imaginary power and it does not grow: it turns, round a circle, as cos θ + i sin θ. A cheaper way to the Imaginary Unit.

puzzle.goal: e^(iωt) goes once round the unit circle and back. Write how long one turn takes, the period T.
puzzle.name: Rotation time
puzzle.method: e^(iθ) = cos θ + i sin θ comes back to 1 when θ = 2π; θ = ωt, so t = 2π/ω.
